title: Wanderstead — Gloam forest floor / 原创夜林地面

art_source.kind: AI-generated material swatches, then deterministic texture synthesis and original procedural Blender geometry
art_source.inspection: Four usable orthographic photographic material swatches: moss, compacted soil, leaf duff, slate grit. No horizon, props, perspective or reference pixels. Crop inset removes atlas-region transitions.
art_source.reference_use: reference/rogue-genesia/night.jpg studied only for damp quiet forest, broken vegetation silhouettes and fine-scale grazing-light detail. Not sampled or embedded.
art_source.third_party_asset_license: No downloaded third-party texture or mesh is used. Original generated image is retained with tool/model provenance; service terms continue to apply.

processing: Four inset material crops; low-frequency illumination suppression preserves actual albedo microstructure.
Revision 2 retargets each source swatch to 3.6 metres: leaf and mineral groups remain readable at the actual 2560x1440 camera instead of dissolving into sand-like high-frequency detail.

Metre-based smoothly warped mirrored sampling uses a 94% primary / 6% secondary blend, preserving individual photographic forms. Sharper irregular moss islands, warm duff colonies and mineral pockets replace uniform material mixing.

OpenGL normal relief is filtered to centimetre-scale leaf ridges instead of sand noise. Linear packed ORM uses G=roughness; metallicFactor=0 makes all ground nonmetal regardless of the exporter's unused B fill value. Wet sediment edges have lower roughness.
Opaque folded arcing grass blades, 0.23-0.53 metre hero grasses in three lamplit colonies, broken shoulder bands, larger fern leaflets, grouped 5-12 cm fallen leaves and 9-28 cm slate fragments.
Undergrowth shares one vertex-colour PBR material and uses light-catching upward-biased grass normals; geometry sectors retain frustum culling.
Three irregular drainage ribbons depress the terrain; low-roughness water with sub-degree normal ripples meets dark wet sediment rather than forming regular discs.
The shallow-water material registers the forest albedo to the terrain on UV1, with ripples tiled independently on UV0. Screen-space highlights therefore lie over a continuous, textured silt bed.
A standard Separate glTF export is packaged into a geometry-only floor.glb with external PNG URI references. No runtime texture is also embedded in the GLB; the file stays below 100 MiB.
revision_2_feedback: Main-agent Bevy screenshot captures/gloam/first-light.png: gray sand-like surface and black pin grasses. Revision changes only owned terrain art, never camera/light/sprite code.

integration.coordinates: Bevy X-right, Y-up, Z-toward-camera; Blender source maps game (x,y,z) to (x,-z,y) before standard glTF Y-up export.
integration.contacts: Traveller (.55,.55), lamp projection (1.5,.83), lamp pole (2.07,.77), boulder (-3,-1) have flattened Y=0 patches. ground_height in terrain_field.py is the placement authority elsewhere.
integration.casting: Opaque actual geometry, including short plants, can cast and receive normal PBR shadows. No alpha blending or alpha-card sorting is required.
integration.lighting: No lamps, lights, camera, sky, emissive objects, UI or animations in exported Scene0. Main scene supplies lighting; sky reflections on the low-roughness drainage water require an EnvironmentMapLight or reflection probe.

中文说明: 地面不是背景图；远景延伸到 Z=-38，地面无围边。角色与灯柱脚下保持水平，主角前方不放高蕨；细节使用物理尺度与真实几何。
